notes: Deep ref and converted source read in full; every quotation checked against the source. Two systemic problems: (1) Scrum Guide 2020 content imported and presented as the Field Guide's — the Topic One/Two/Three structure and 'why is this Sprint valuable?', 'The Sprint Goal must be finalized prior to the end of Sprint Planning', 'communicates why the Sprint is valuable to stakeholders', 'Implementing only parts of Scrum is possible, the result is not Scrum', and the Product Goal. The Field Guide (April 2020) predates the November 2020 Scrum Guide, so none of these can be its content. (2) Loose quotation discipline: seven unmarked verbatim passages, two quotation-marked strings that are not the source's words (lines 185, 186), and a marker note that describes a paraphrase-only file. Short quoted fragments at lines 14 ('gaming the system'), 192 and 212 ('bare minimum') are verbatim and were left FAITHFUL. Source-level arithmetic error the distillation inherits: the Velocity worked example (25/45 + 24/43 + 31/50)/3 × 47 = 27.16, not the author's stated ≈30 (the deep ref faithfully records ≈30 as the author's figure, [AP]). Concept 6 and the worked example repeat ≈30; they are FAITHFUL to the deep ref, but the worked example's carry-over logic turns on that number (D024), and the deep ref and source should carry a note that the stated result does not follow from the stated inputs.
